metric_convention: RMSE ratio sqrt(candidate MSE / Stage-A MSE) on identical declared validation rows

trace_role.construction: 20x20 spatial cell centers at t=0; four walls at 20 tangential x 1000 temporal cell centers
trace_role.mixed_individual_ratio_rule: max over j of E_B[j] / max(E_A[j], 0.01*E_A[matching group component mean])
trace_role.target: rest IC; side/bottom no slip; top u=16*x^2*(1-x)^2*g(t), v=0; g is the frozen t_r=0.5 quintic ramp
